status: Frozen defaults. Task 6 may finalise the items listed under open_for_task6 BEFORE the final split is evaluated; afterwards nothing here changes.

algorithms: ensemble(5 x dqn, randomised prior + bootstrapped replay)

splits.train: env map stream (SeedSequence [seed,0x5EED,i]); disjoint from the splits below by construction and verified by grid hashing

val.use: checkpoint selection, OOD/uncertainty threshold calibration (in-distribution preset only)

test.use: reserved; its greedy SR was printed by Task-1/3 training scripts (never used for any decision) so it is NOT used for confirmatory claims

final.use: confirmatory evaluation; never touched before the freeze; access logged in results/test_access.jsonl; requires a clean `freeze.py verify`

pilot.use: debugging / runtime estimate only; never reported as a result

thresholds.calibration_data: in-distribution validation maps only (seeds 10000-10099), plain-ensemble rollouts

evaluation.success_definition: terminal reason == goal; a safe stop is a mission failure reported separately
evaluation.statistics: mean +/- 95% t-interval over seeds; paired differences over matched (map, seed) pairs; Wilson interval for single-policy proportions

open_for_task6: which paired tests / multiplicity correction to use
whether the 'test' split is dropped or reported as exploratory
